name: rule34video-media-filter
description: Cross-browser Manifest V3 extension for a local, filterable Rule34Video subscription catalogue.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.5.0 lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.5.0 run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.5.0 build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
